verdicts.reason: A keeps a sensible top-to-bottom order (quote → attribution → bottle → CTA → logo), but the quote mark floats about 80px above the headline, leaving a dead band. The one-line quote runs almost to the right edge, and the pink circle has come loose from the bottle and sits clipped as an orphan in the bottom-right corner. B scrambles the reading order: the CTA pill and the logo sit at the top before any message, the small bottle is jammed under them, and the quote mark and headline drop to the lower half. That leaves a large empty bottom with the same orphaned, clipped circle, and the logo and CTA, which are unevenly spaced, compete as the first focal point.
